# Neotoma durable ICP — Candidate B

## Archetype

Technically fluent operator who feels the pain of ad-hoc agent state and will not build their own state infrastructure

## Stack

Two or more AI agents/assistants in regular use (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT); MCP-configurable harness; today's install path is npm + CLI (guided app install is intended, not shipped)

## Core job to be done

Keep what agents learn from disappearing between sessions and tools; correct a fact once and have it hold everywhere, traceably; stop being the human sync layer across every AI tool — without taking on infrastructure engineering to get there

## Trigger moment

Chronic: re-prompting tax becomes viscerally annoying after 2+ weeks of daily multi-tool use, or crosses 3+ agents / 5+ life-work domains. Acute (the converting event, Q11 — strongest single qualifier): agent acts confidently on wrong, stale, or lossy-compressed state and the damage surfaces downstream — a reverted decision built on it, a nuanced choice flattened and silently overwritten.

## Messaging — good

State the problem as an integrity failure, not a recall failure — nothing was committed to a record, so there is nothing to forget and nothing to correct (plan ent_98ef9d45f8a6896fed408f8f, decision never_say_the_agent_forgot). Lead with the acute crisis, not the chronic tax (see analysis on chronic-vs-acute pain, this run). Frame Neotoma as removing a tax, not adding a capability: 'technically fluent about state; wants to own the data, not the plumbing' (primary_icp.md, revised 2026-09-15 per O1).

## Messaging — bad (anti-profile)

ANTI-PROFILE, sourced from the durable-ICP ruling (O1, 2026-09-15) rather than re-argued here: NOT the infrastructure builder who would write their own state layer from scratch — that person is Candidate A, now an early-adopter/validator cohort in secondary_icps.md, not the durable buyer (plan ent_98ef9d45f8a6896fed408f8f decision candidate_a_moves_to_secondary_icps). NOT someone who requires that nothing run on their own machine — the one durable install exclusion that survived the 2026-09-15 correction (the old 'needs zero-install onboarding' exclusion was removed because it disqualified the actual buyer; 'guided install' is not 'no install'). NOT a casual note-taker/PKM user (no human-first editing model). NOT a procurement-led enterprise buyer (team revenue is a pull-through bet from individual adopters, not a direct sales motion — decision team_revenue_is_a_pull_through_bet, O2). Do not qualify or disqualify on willingness to operate today's npm/CLI install path — that is friction to remove, not a fit signal (primary_icp.md qualification note on Q10).

## Ideal entry point

Personal install for one's own multi-agent workflow (contacts, tasks, decisions, code context) across Claude Code and Cursor; activation threshold markers are 3+ agents operating across sessions, 5+ life/work domains managed through agents, or the first unattended/overnight agent run where state integrity stops being optional.

## Summary

CONSUMED from the product's decision register (path 3: register has settled it — project, do not re-derive). The durable ICP is Candidate B: technically fluent about state, will not build their own state infrastructure, converts on the acute crisis of an agent acting on bad state rather than the chronic tax of re-prompting. Ratified by the operator 2026-09-15 (decision durable_icp_is_candidate_b on plan ent_98ef9d45f8a6896fed408f8f), merged in neotoma#2414 ('docs: make Candidate B the durable ICP and remove the install barrier'). Category noun resolved via the same register: 'the system of record for AI agents' (decision category_noun_singularity, 2026-08-21), merged in neotoma#2404. Reviewed by: copy_positioning (manucode, per swarm roster ent_5cd7bca79b8d9f806ab79fb9).
